Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
Would you be so kind as to send an order for me for Sir F.

Palgraves History of Normandy and England. I cannot get my [Cameo’s](/book/73) [sic] correct without it, and [Dr Moberly](/person/1015)’s copy on which I reckoned proves to be packed up for leaving Winchester so as to be unobtainable. I can do nothing till I get it, and though I could order it from the [London Library](/organisation/29), one is kept often very long waiting for that kind of book.

If I knew who was the publisher I would write direct, but I cannot remember.

Pray tell [Mrs Craik](/person/378) when you see her that [Mme de Witt](/person/423) writes to me that [M Guizot](/person/597) considers her 'Two Marriages' 'comme un chef d’ouvre' [sic]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: The printed address has been cut out of the MS.
